content: We spotted a great deal on Tile trackers earlier this week that’s still live, but if you’re an iPhone owner, we ultimately recommend Apple’s latest AirTag. Right now, you can pick up a four-pack for $89 ($10 off) at Amazon and Target, matching the bundle’s all-time low price. If you’re a member, Costco also has a deal that throws in a fifth AirTag for free. [Product: Apple AirTags (second-generation) | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-AirTag-2nd-Generation-Precision/dp/B0GJTXVN9Z?tag=theverge02-20, https://goto.target.com/c/482924/81938/2092?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fp%2Fapple-airtag-4-pack-2nd-generation%2F-%2FA-85990990] A growing number of Bluetooth trackers can tap into Apple’s Find My network these days, but none combine that with Apple’s latest ultra wideband (UWB) chip, which powers even better Precision Finding than before. Precision Finding uses on-screen arrows and distance indicators in the Find My app to guide you directly to a misplaced item, while the second-generation AirTag’s upgraded chip and extended Bluetooth range make it faster and more reliable to locate tags, even in multistory homes. You can also use Precision Finding to find lost items on an Apple Watch, provided you have a Series 9 or later. And if all else fails, the built-in speaker is noticeably louder than before, making it easier to track down an AirTag by sound. Plus, like its predecessor, the second-generation AirTag comes with a handful of features that are especially useful if you’re traveling this summer. AirTag sharing lets up to five people keep track of the same item, while Apple’s Share Item Location feature allows you to temporarily share an AirTag’s location with participating airlines, including United, Delta, and American Airlines. It’s still a shame Apple doesn’t include a built-in lanyard hole, meaning you’ll need to buy a separate loop or holder, but the tracker continues to use a replaceable CR2032 battery, so you won’t have to replace the entire device when it eventually runs out of power. And at $89 for a four-pack, it’s also a little easier on your wallet today. Read our second-generation AirTag review.

chineseContent: 本周早些时候，我们在 Tile 追踪器上发现了很多优惠，目前仍然有效，但如果您是 iPhone 用户，我们最终推荐 Apple 最新的 AirTag。现在，您可以在 Amazon 和 Target 上以 89 美元（优惠 10 美元）的价格购买四件装，与该捆绑包的历史最低价格相匹配。如果您是会员，Costco 还提供免费赠送第五个 AirTag 的优惠。 [产品：Apple AirTags（第二代）| https://www.amazon.com/Apple-AirTag-2nd-Generation-Precision/dp/B0GJTXVN9Z?tag=theverge02-20， https://goto.target.com/c/482924/81938/2092?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.target.com%2Fp%2Fapple-airtag-4-pack-2nd- Generation%2F-%2FA-85990990] 如今，越来越多的蓝牙跟踪器可以接入 Apple 的“查找我的”网络，但没有一个将其与 Apple 最新的超宽带 (UWB) 结合起来芯片，其提供比以前更好的精确定位。精确查找功能使用“查找我的”应用程序中的屏幕箭头和距离指示器直接引导您找到丢失的物品，而第二代 AirTag 的升级芯片和扩展的蓝牙范围使定位标签更快、更可靠，即使在多层住宅中也是如此。如果您拥有 Series 9 或更高版本，您还可以使用精确查找功能在 Apple Watch 上查找丢失的物品。如果其他方法都失败了，内置扬声器的声音明显比以前大，从而可以更轻松地通过声音追踪 AirTag。此外，与其前身一样，第二代 AirTag 还配备了一些功能，如果您今年夏天旅行，这些功能特别有用。 AirTag 共享最多可让 5 人跟踪同一物品，而 Apple 的共享物品位置功能可让您与参与的航空公司（包括联合航空、达美航空和美国航空）临时共享 AirTag 的位置。苹果不包括一个仍然是一个遗憾
